message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul
INC="-Iinclude -Ibuild/host/include -Imrbgems/mruby-time/include -Imrbgems/mruby-io/include"
CFLAGS="-std=gnu99 -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DMRB_USE_RATIONAL -DMRB_USE_COMPLEX"
count=0; fail=0
# mrblib
gcc $CFLAGS $INC -c build/host/mrblib/mrblib.c -o /tmp/mrbobj/mrblib.o 2>/tmp/err.txt && count=$((count+1)) || { fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL mrblib"; head -5 /tmp/err.txt; }
# compiler gem
for c in mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/y.tab.c; do
  base=$(basename "$c" .c)
  gcc $CFLAGS $INC -c "$c" -o "/tmp/mrbobj/gem_${base}.o" 2>/tmp/err.txt && count=$((count+1)) || { fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL: $c"; head -5 /tmp/err.txt; }
done
echo "mrblib+compiler: compiled=$count failed=$fail"
